note: Synthetic recognition prompts. These are textbook drills, not learner attempts.

prompts.prompt: A stream of user IDs arrives. Report whether the current ID has appeared before.
prompts.constraints: up to 200k IDs; order otherwise irrelevant
prompts.deciding_signal: online repeated membership lookup

prompts.prompt: Group records by a canonical signature while preserving duplicate counts.
prompts.deciding_signal: key→group/frequency state avoids repeated comparisons

prompts.prompt: Find a target-sum pair in ascending values.
prompts.deciding_signal: sorted order lets one comparison eliminate a boundary with O(1) extra space

prompts.prompt: Find a target-sum pair, but the values are unsorted and original indices must be returned.
prompts.deciding_signal: no ordering proof; exact complement lookup preserves indices

prompts.prompt: Longest contiguous positive-number segment whose sum stays at most K.
prompts.tempting: prefix sum + binary search every start
prompts.deciding_signal: validity repairs monotonically as left moves

prompts.prompt: Shortest contiguous segment with sum at least K; values may be negative.
prompts.deciding_signal: negative values break monotonic boundary repair

prompts.prompt: Validate nested delimiters in one pass.
prompts.deciding_signal: most recent unresolved opener must match first

prompts.prompt: Jobs must be processed in exactly arrival order; each is removed once.
prompts.deciding_signal: FIFO ownership, not nested undo

prompts.prompt: Find an exact value in a sorted array.
prompts.deciding_signal: one comparison discards half of sorted search space

prompts.prompt: Find the minimum capacity such that a simulator finishes by a deadline.
prompts.constraints: capacity range huge; feasibility only gets easier as capacity rises
prompts.deciding_signal: monotonic feasible/infeasible boundary

prompts.prompt: Return one minimum value from a static array exactly once.
prompts.deciding_signal: no repeated extremum query justifies maintained order

prompts.prompt: After every insertion, report the current smallest task priority.
prompts.tempting: sort whole list after each insert
prompts.deciding_signal: repeated online extremum under updates

prompts.prompt: Reverse a singly linked list in-place.
prompts.deciding_signal: node links, not random access, are the mutable state

prompts.prompt: Detect whether a linked list contains a cycle without extra set storage.
prompts.deciding_signal: relative pointer speed exposes repeated node state

prompts.prompt: Check whether every value in a binary tree is inside a propagated valid range.
prompts.tempting: only compare node with its parent
prompts.deciding_signal: ancestor constraints survive across recursive subtree state

prompts.prompt: Repeatedly search exact keys in a balanced BST.
prompts.deciding_signal: ordering removes one entire subtree per comparison

prompts.prompt: Compute a factorial-like definition where each call reduces n by one.
prompts.deciding_signal: single shrinking chain; no overlapping subproblems

prompts.prompt: A recursive graph walk may reach depth 500k in Python.
prompts.deciding_signal: algorithm valid, call-stack implementation unsafe

prompts.prompt: Generate all valid arrangements under local constraints for N=9.
prompts.deciding_signal: must enumerate construction paths and undo local choices

prompts.prompt: Count ways for N=200 where many different choice paths reach the same remaining state.
prompts.deciding_signal: overlapping state makes tree branches repeat work

prompts.prompt: Store a sparse undirected graph for traversal.
prompts.deciding_signal: sparse edge set; neighbor iteration dominates

prompts.prompt: Dense graph with V=300 needs constant-time edge-existence checks repeatedly.
prompts.deciding_signal: density and query type can justify matrix despite textbook preference

prompts.prompt: Find minimum hops from one source in an unweighted maze.
prompts.deciding_signal: FIFO layers correspond exactly to path length

prompts.prompt: Mark every cell connected to a starting cell; no distance requested.
prompts.deciding_signal: reachability only; traversal order is not part of correctness

prompts.prompt: Process 300k union(a,b) and connected(a,b) operations.
prompts.deciding_signal: dynamic component state repeats across queries

prompts.prompt: Return an actual route between two nodes in a static component.
prompts.deciding_signal: DSU discards path structure

prompts.prompt: Schedule tasks so every prerequisite comes first.
prompts.constraints: dependency graph intended to be acyclic
prompts.deciding_signal: indegree zero represents readiness, not distance

prompts.prompt: Dependency processing starts with no ready node even though tasks remain.
prompts.tempting: pick arbitrary task to continue topo
prompts.deciding_signal: topological progress failure is evidence of a cycle

prompts.prompt: Find cheapest routes from one source; all edge weights are nonnegative.
prompts.deciding_signal: cost frontier must be ordered by tentative distance, not hop layer

prompts.prompt: Find cheapest routes but one edge may have negative cost.
prompts.deciding_signal: negative edge breaks Dijkstra finalization proof

prompts.prompt: Choose non-overlapping activities to maximize count when sorting by finish time has an exchange proof.
prompts.deciding_signal: provable local choice leaves maximal room for remaining activities

prompts.prompt: Choose rewards where a locally largest item changes future feasible rewards unpredictably.
prompts.deciding_signal: no exchange proof; future value depends on state

prompts.prompt: Answer millions of range-sum queries on an immutable array.
prompts.deciding_signal: same prefix work repeats across static queries

prompts.prompt: Range-sum queries interleave with point updates.
prompts.deciding_signal: precomputed prefixes become stale after each update

prompts.prompt: Merge overlapping intervals given all intervals up front.
prompts.deciding_signal: ordered starts make only the current merged frontier relevant

prompts.prompt: Intervals arrive online and must answer coverage queries between arrivals.
prompts.deciding_signal: offline preprocessing cannot include future updates

prompts.prompt: Naive Fibonacci recursion repeats fib(k) from many branches.
prompts.deciding_signal: same subproblem state is recomputed

prompts.prompt: A recursive divide-and-conquer splits into disjoint halves with no repeated state.
prompts.deciding_signal: recursion alone does not imply DP; overlap is missing

prompts.prompt: Best score at index i depends only on best score at i-1 and i-2.
prompts.deciding_signal: one-dimensional state and short dependency horizon

prompts.prompt: Need to reconstruct the chosen path after a 1D optimization DP.
prompts.deciding_signal: output requires reconstruction evidence, not only final value

prompts.prompt: Count paths through a grid where state depends on top and left cells.
prompts.deciding_signal: state naturally has two coordinates; compression comes after definition

prompts.prompt: Grid path decision includes obstacles revealed only by current cell.
prompts.deciding_signal: DAG-like state order means predecessors are already final

prompts.prompt: Each item may be chosen at most once under a capacity.
prompts.deciding_signal: iteration must prevent current item from being reused

prompts.prompt: Each item may be used unlimited times under capacity.
prompts.deciding_signal: current item reuse changes transition/iteration direction

prompts.prompt: Find LIS length for N=1500.
prompts.deciding_signal: constraint budget may allow state-definition-first DP

prompts.prompt: Find LIS length for N=300k.
prompts.deciding_signal: quadratic predecessor scan crosses the scale boundary

prompts.prompt: For each value, find the next greater value to its right.
prompts.deciding_signal: current values can resolve multiple unresolved earlier candidates once

prompts.prompt: For every width-K window, report its maximum.
prompts.deciding_signal: candidates must expire by age as the left boundary moves

prompts.prompt: For every width-K window, report maximum while values stream in.
prompts.deciding_signal: maintain surviving candidates across overlapping windows

prompts.prompt: Need one maximum over the entire static array.
prompts.deciding_signal: no window expiration or repeated query exists

prompts.prompt: Autocomplete repeatedly asks whether any stored word begins with a prefix.
prompts.deciding_signal: prefix path itself is the query state

prompts.prompt: Perform exact membership for a static set of strings; no prefix query exists.
prompts.deciding_signal: exact key lookup needs no prefix structure

prompts.prompt: Check whether an integer is a power of two.
prompts.deciding_signal: binary representation has exactly one set bit

prompts.prompt: Need counts of values across arbitrary large integer keys.
prompts.deciding_signal: bit tricks do not replace sparse key→count state

prompts.prompt: Enumerate all subsets of 18 features and test a compact compatibility rule.
prompts.deciding_signal: small N makes subset state representable directly by bits

prompts.prompt: Same subset objective but N=50 and score splits cleanly into two halves.
prompts.deciding_signal: constraint mutation changes exponential strategy without changing objective
